name: nanab-berry
effect: No effect; only useful for planting and cooking.
shortEffect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.

flavorTextEntries.text: POKéBLOCK ingredient. Plant in loamy soil to grow NANAB.
Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.
A Poffin ingredient. Bury it in soft soil to grow a Nanab Plant.
In the Sinnoh region, they like to make sweets known as Poffins with this Berry and feed them to their Pokémon.
A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
A Berry to be used in cooking. This Berry is very rare and hard to obtain in the Unova region.
Used to make Pokéblocks that will enhance your Cuteness. Its pink flesh is sweet when eaten.
A Berry that calms wild Pokémon you’re trying to catch slightly when given to them.
